info.title: Laksamana API v1 — account, jadwal, marketing
info.description: Hand-written contract for the `/api/v1` surface of the account, jadwal and marketing modules. Sanctum Bearer auth; the shared `{data, meta}` / `{error:{code,message,details}}` envelopes (App\Support\Api\ApiResponse) are the components below. The drift check `tools/openapi-check.php` keeps this list in step with `php artisan route:list --path=api/v1`.

tags.name: account
tags.description: Office users, modules, roster and imports.

tags.name: jadwal
tags.description: Schedule cells, shifts, roster, requests and settings.

tags.name: marketing
tags.description: Marketing state, records, activities, documents and files.

Success.description: The shared success envelope. `meta` carries versions (e.g. `version`, `versions`, `total`).

Record.description: A row of `{resource}`; `id` is the legacy id (kept in `legacy_id` on core). `meta.version` is the row version.

put.summary: Activate or deactivate an Office User
Set the modules a User administers
Activate or deactivate a roster user

post.summary: Import users and modules from a legacy payload

get.summary: List schedule cells in a date range
List the roster with division and shift
